text: A truly underrated app! I fell in love with it from the first minute of use! · Only the necessary features, because many trackers have so many unnecessary ones that you start wasting time learning them. · The interface is amazing, pretty colors and style, minimalistic. I can only recommend making the font of the skills a little different and bolder (for example, like "History" or "Rating"). I wish you all the best and thank you very-very-very much for this application!!🤍
author: Vitalina Kobyzka
